extension.summary: Films and TV with Trakt, TMDB and Premiumize
extension.description: SpongeTV brings Trakt syncing, TMDB metadata, Premiumize and your own provider packages together in one add-on. This is a stage 4 test build: browsing, metadata, Trakt, provider packages and playback through Premiumize.
extension.disclaimer: SpongeTV includes no content providers. You are responsible for the provider packages you install.
extension.news: 1.0.5: A second measuring build with no change to how SpongeTV works. With Kodi's debug logging on, the log now also shows each step of building a list (for example Next up and Shows in progress) and how many cache reads, database lookups and network requests it made. This is to find what makes those lists slow. 1.0.4: Menus open faster. SpongeTV now loads its network library, and each part of its own code, only when a list or action needs it. On an NVIDIA Shield, loading everything took about 0.7 seconds each time any menu opened; plain menus and lists SpongeTV has already saved no longer pay that. Lists that fetch from TMDB or Trakt still need the network library. 1.0.3: A measuring build with no change to how SpongeTV works. With Kodi's debug logging on, the log now says how long each list or action took: loading the network library, loading SpongeTV's code, and the work itself. This is to see whether menus can be made to open faster. 1.0.2: The Premiumize days in Settings, Accounts are now refreshed about 20 seconds after Kodi starts and whenever you use Check Premiumize account, so the two always agree. SpongeTV's own resume points moved to a table of their own (existing ones are carried over), so nothing that clears the cache can touch them. Earlier changes: changelog.txt
